raw.body:
test: pin steps --json for the unsupported operationPath form

Review follow-ups for the describe-surface classifier change. A new
contract snapshot runs steps --json against the unsupported
specification-form fixture at the process boundary, pinning that the
step row carries the target verbatim and omits the method key entirely
(the runtime refuses the value before deriving a method). The MCP
ParsedStepTarget gains the same routing doc comment its CLI twin got.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
